Hi everyone, question about converting drivers licenses on a B2 visa: Our interview appointment to get a B1 visa is in January. Misrad Hapnim extended my B2 visa until February, now that I have a visa with a long validity, can I convert my license? My foreign license is expiring on September 12th, and I can’t renew it in my country because they do not issue drivers licenses to non-residents.
Thanks!
